title: Table
description: Displays rows of data. Use Table with columns and data for the common case, TableRoot and its parts for custom headers or merged cells, and DataTable for pagination, loading and error states.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Each column reads row[key] unless it has a render function. Give rows a stable rowKey.

variants.title: Variants and sizes
variants.description: Simple, striped or bordered rows, in small, medium or large density, optionally highlighted on hover.

fixed-columns.title: Fixed columns and scrolling
fixed-columns.description: scroll.x sets a minimum width, scroll.y bounds the height with a sticky header. Fixed columns need a width and must be declared at the start (left) or end (right); ellipsis truncates long text.

states.title: Loading and empty states
states.description: loading renders skeleton rows (hidden from assistive technologies); an empty data array renders emptyText.

data-table.title: DataTable
data-table.description: Adds pagination under the table and replaces it with an alert and a retry button when error is set. Rows must already be paginated.

compound.title: Compound parts
compound.description: TableRoot, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeader and TableCell render native table elements for multi-row headers or merged cells.

cell-content.title: Cell content
cell-content.description: TableCellContent bounds and wraps long content, with an optional muted secondary line or monospace primary text.

sorting.title: Sorting
sorting.description: sortable makes a header a button cycling ascending, descending and unsorted (aria-sort follows). true compares row[key]; a function compares two rows. Control the state with sortState and onSortChange, or use manualSort to sort on a server.

selection.title: Row selection
selection.description: rowSelection adds a checkbox column with a select-all checkbox (indeterminate when partially selected). Disabled rows are skipped by select-all; selected rows get aria-selected and a highlight.

TableProps.rowKey: Extracts a stable key from a row (defaults to the row index)
TableProps.emptyText: Content of the single row shown when data is empty
TableProps.loading: Renders placeholder skeleton rows instead of the data
TableProps.loadingRows: Number of skeleton rows rendered while loading
TableProps.onSortChange: Called with the next sort state when a sortable header is activated
TableProps.manualSort: Skips local sorting: data is rendered as given (sorted by its owner, e.g. a server) while the headers reflect the sort state
TableProps.rowSelection: Adds a leading checkbox column to select rows

TableColumn.key: Unique key of the column; also the default field read from each row
TableColumn.render: Renders a cell; defaults to row[key]
TableColumn.width: Column width (numbers are pixels), applied as width and min-width; required for fixed columns
TableColumn.align: Horizontal alignment of the header and cells
TableColumn.ellipsis: Truncates the content on a single line with an ellipsis
TableColumn.fixed: Sticks the column to the left or right edge while scrolling horizontally
TableColumn.sortable: Makes the column sortable: true compares row[key] (empty values last), a function (a, b) => number compares two rows for the ascending order

DataTableProps.pagination: Pagination props rendered under the table (rows must already be paginated)
DataTableProps.error: Error message; replaces the table and pagination with an alert
DataTableProps.onRetry: Called by the retry button shown with error

TableRootProps.variant: Visual style: plain rows, zebra stripes or bordered cells
TableRootProps.scroll: Horizontal minimum width / vertical maximum height of the scroll area; a scrolling wrapper becomes a focusable region named after the table (default: "Scrollable table")

TableScrollConfig.x: Minimum width of the table; the wrapper scrolls horizontally when narrower
TableScrollConfig.y: Maximum visible height; the wrapper scrolls vertically and the header sticks

TableSortState.order: Sort direction ("ascend" or "descend"); null means unsorted

TableRowSelection.defaultSelectedRowKeys: Keys of the initially selected rows (uncontrolled)
TableRowSelection.onChange: Called with the new selected keys and the matching rows of data
TableRowSelection.getCheckboxProps: Per-row checkbox options; disabled rows cannot be toggled and are skipped by select-all
TableRowSelection.getRowLabel: Names a row in the accessible label of its checkbox ("Select row {name}"); defaults to the row key

TableCellContentProps.secondary: Secondary, muted content under the primary content
TableCellContentProps.monospace: Renders the primary content as <code> in the monospace font
TableCellContentProps.maxWidth: Maximum width (numbers are pixels); long content wraps

FixedColumnLayout.leftOffsets: Left offset (px) of every left-fixed column, by column key
FixedColumnLayout.rightOffsets: Right offset (px) of every right-fixed column, by column key
FixedColumnLayout.lastLeftFixedKey: Last column of the leading left-fixed block (gets the edge shadow)
FixedColumnLayout.firstRightFixedKey: First column of the trailing right-fixed block (gets the edge shadow)

cssVars.--table-cell-padding-y: Vertical padding of the cells (every size; follows the density by default)
cssVars.--table-cell-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the cells (every size; follows the density by default)
cssVars.--table-font-size: Font size of the body cells (every size)
cssVars.--table-header-bg: Background color of the header row
cssVars.--table-radius: Corner radius of the wrapper (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--table-stripe-bg: Background color of the odd rows of a striped table
cssVars.--table-hover-bg: Background color of the hovered row of a hoverable table
cssVars.--table-selected-bg: Background color of the selected rows (row selection)
cssVars.--table-sort-icon-color: Color of the sort indicator of an unsorted sortable column
cssVars.--table-focus-ring-color: Outline color of the focused scroll region
